name: Elmbridge Xcel Leisure Complex
summary: Elmbridge Xcel offers swimming, climbing, sport, exercise and active family sessions: two pools, a gym, fitness studios, a sports hall, a 12.5-metre climbing wall, soft play and a health suite with sauna and steam facilities, plus a Costa Coffee area.
reasonToVisit: A full leisure complex: pools, climbing wall, gym, soft play and sports hall in one site
